Title: 2025-07-29 Live Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Events:
  • Nexomania II has arrived in the Nexus!
  Gameplay:
  • On death reveal duration on nearby units removed.
  • Knockback effects have been updated to be more consistent.
  • Reduced the impact Roots have on Knockback effects.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Catapults no longer give Experience (previously 1).

=== Battlegrounds: Dragon Shire ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Vehicle's Basic Attacks to not consume Evasion charges.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the on-death knockback from Vehicles to move the target in the direction the target is moving when first applied.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the on-death knockback from Vehicles to not knock all targets back an equal distance.

=== Battlegrounds: Volskaya Foundry ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Vehicle's Basic Attacks to not consume Evasion charges.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the on-death knockback from Vehicles to move the target in the direction the target is moving when first applied.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the on-death knockback from Vehicles to not knock all targets back an equal distance.

=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Basic Attack damage increased from 150 to 160.
  • Lightning Surge [E]
    • Healing increased from 70 to 75.
  • Telekinesis [W]
    • Knockback speed now slows down over the duration of the knockback.
    • Push-to-point distance increased from 6.25 from where Telekinesis was targeted to 12.5.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Overwhelming Power
      • Rework: Healing reduced from 50% to 15% of damage dealt.
      • Rework: Percent of damage converted to Healing is now increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when attacking Heroes (For example: At 100% Sadism, this will be 65% of damage dealt).
  • Level 7
    • Applied Force
      • Now pushes targets 15% further.
  • Level 20
    • Counter-Strike
      • Removed.
    • Deadly Charge
      • Removed.
    • (New) Might of the Highlord
      • Alarak gains access to his other Heroic which occupies the Trait slot. This also grants an ability to swap which slot each Heroic occupies.
    • (New) Wrath of the Highlord
      • If Counter-Strike is Alarak's Heroic, Basic Abilities reduce its cooldown by ~~3~~ 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero they hit.
      • If Deadly Charge is Alarak's Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge ~~have their Armor reduced by 50 for 4 seconds~~ now take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Telekinesis [W]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Telekinesis to not interrupt targets hit.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Wing Buffet [W]
      • Targets are now knocked away from a point 2 range behind where Wing Buffet was cast, instead of Alexstrasza's position. Targets will now move in the direction where Wing Buffet was cast.
  • Level 20
    • Blessing of the Red
      • Fixed an issue that caused Blessing of the Red's transfer effect to not maintain Alexstrasza as the caster.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 10
    • Wandering Keg
      • Fixed an issue that caused Wandering Keg to not knock all targets back an equal distance.
      • Hitting an enemy while already affected by its self-applied Slow will no longer cause the Slow to be removed faster than intended.
      • Targets are now knocked away from a point .75 range behind Chen at the point of impact.

      • Wandering Keg's self-applied Slow will now be also increased in strength to match the increased movement speed gained from Untapped Potential.
